annotation.authors_or_issuer: Feng, Z.; Wang, Z.; Hu, L.
key_provisions_or_claims: Social bots shape media agendas and online public opinion, with foreign bots seen as threatening China's opinion environment.
Recommends AI screening of public social accounts and regulations standardizing media behavior.
Proposes technical identification of hostile social bots on domestic platforms.
Advocates deploying Chinese social bots overseas to shape foreign public sentiment and divide opinion camps.
annotation.summary_en: Chinese journal article on social bots (software accounts) shaping online media agendas. It proposes a national defense system—AI screening of accounts, regulation of media behavior, blocking foreign bots—and an offensive strategy of deploying Chinese social bots overseas to influence foreign public opinion.
annotation.title_clean: Social Robots and Internet Opinion Rights
annotation.title_en: Social Robots and Internet Opinion Rights
annotation.venue: Journal of New Media and Economics
